data.name: Ehtesham
data.gender_notes: Ehtesham is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who is given respect, esteemed or honored. The name Ehtesham carries the meaning “Respect, Esteem” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Ehtesham usually hope their child will grow to embody respect, esteem and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that signifies the respect and reverence due to Allah, and the respect and honor due to other human beings
data.etymology: Ehtesham belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Respect, Esteem.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ehtesham total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_arabic.name: إحتشام
in_arabic.meaning: إحتشام يعني الوقار والهيبة والشوق إلى الله
in_arabic.long_meaning: إحتشام هو اسم مشتق من الجذر العربي 'حشم' الذي يعني الوقار والهيبة. في اللغة العربية، يعني الإحتشام التوقير والتعظيم لله، وهو من الأسماء التي تعبر عن صفات الله الحسنى. وقد ورد في القرآن الكريم ذكر الحشمة كصفة من صفات المتقين.

in_urdu.name: احتشام
in_urdu.meaning: احتشام کا مطلب ہے عزت، وقار، اور اللہ کی طرف سے ہدایت
in_urdu.long_meaning: احتشام ایک عربی نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے عزت، وقار، اور اللہ کی طرف سے ہدایت. یہ نام احتشام کے عربی جڑ سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے عزت اور توقیر. جنوبی ایشیاء میں مسلمانوں کے ذریعہ یہ نام اہم سمجھا جاتا ہے.

in_hindi.name: احتشाम
in_hindi.meaning: احتشाम का अर्थ है सम्मान, गरिमा, और ईश्वर की ओर से मार्गदर्शन
in_hindi.long_meaning: احتشام एक अरबी नाम है जिसका अर्थ है सम्मान, गरिमा, और ईश्वर की ओर से मार्गदर्शन. यह नाम अरबी जड़ 'حشم' से निकला है, जिसका अर्थ है सम्मान और गरिमा. भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में यह नाम महत्वपूर्ण माना जाता है.

in_pashto.name: احتشام
in_pashto.meaning: احتشام د معنی لري عزت، درنښت، او د الله له لوري هدايت
in_pashto.long_meaning: احتشام د عربي نوم څخه اخيستل شوی دی، چې د عزت، درنښت، او د الله له لوري هدايت معنی لري. په افغانستان کې د پښتنو دوديزې ټولنې کې دا نوم د احترام او درنښت د څرګندنې لپاره کارول کېږي.

in_english.name: Ehtesham
in_english.meaning: Ehtesham means dignity, respect, and guidance from Allah
in_english.long_meaning: Ehtesham is derived from the Arabic root 'ḥ-sh-m' which signifies dignity, respect, and majesty. In Islamic tradition, Ehtesham is associated with attributes of Allah, reflecting reverence and awe. The name implies a sense of nobility and spiritual guidance.

pronunciation.urdu: اردو میں تلفظ کی تفصیل: احتشام (eh-teh-SHAAM)
pronunciation.pashto: په پښتو کې د تلفظ تفصیل: احتشام (eh-teh-SHAAM)

data.cultural_impact: The name "Ehtesham" in Islamic culture signifies reverence, respect, and recognition given to individuals, religious symbols, or sacred places. For example, Muslims are expected to show utmost respect for the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) by not only adhering to his moral teachings but also by displaying this respect through actions such as lowering their gaze, covering their heads, and refraining from committing disrespectful acts (such as using his name or image in vain). Similarly, mosques, the holiest places for Muslims, are also sites of great respect and reverence, and Muslims are encouraged to keep them clean and well maintained.
data.spiritual_significance: In the spiritual context, the name "Ehtesham" holds a significant meaning that emphasizes the importance of respecting and honor God's creations and divine ordinances. Islamic teachings emphasize the concept of "Tawhid," or the belief in the oneness of God, as the foundation of all moral and spiritual principles. By demonstrating respect and honor for all of God's creation and His divine law, individuals can develop a deep sense of love, reverence, and obedience towards the divine Creator. The name "Ehtesham" can serve as a reminder of the importance of honoring and respecting the divine origins of all things and as a means of cultivating a more profound connection with the divine through our actions and intentions.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Respect, Esteem" symbolizes One who is given respect, esteemed or honored. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Ehtesham serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of respect, esteem.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Ehtesham was a famous warrior during the Mughal Empire in the 16th century. The name Ehtesham carried significant weight in that era.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Ehtesham remains relevant in modern Muslim society, representing a bridge between traditional Islamic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Islamic names.

name_in_real_life.story: Fatima Ehtesham from Istanbul, Turkey embodies the meaning of Ehtesham - "Respect, Esteem". Growing up, they were known for their strong character and deep faith, always striving to live up to the beautiful significance of their name.
